_about: Emergency red flags checked BEFORE the model (app/red_flags.py). If one matches, the answer is always EMERGENCY / call 112. Patterns are regular expressions, matched case-insensitively on text without accents, in English and French. Sources: NHS 111 'Check it's not an emergency' (111.nhs.uk/triage/check-its-not-an-emergency) and Guichet.lu 'Appel d'urgence 112' (guichet.public.lu, updated 06.11.2024), both checked 2026-11-02. Meningitis and blue-lips rules added 2026-11-09 after cases 13 and 17 of the extended test set were only caught by the model; source: NHS 'Meningitis' symptoms page (nhs.uk/conditions/meningitis).

flags.reason: Chest pain or pressure can be a sign of a heart attack.
Weakness on one side, a drooping face or slurred speech can be signs of a stroke.
Severe difficulty breathing, choking or blue lips need emergency care.
patterns: (very|severely|extremely) short of breath|short(ness)? of breath at rest|difficulty breathing|choking|gasping

flags.reason: Loss of consciousness or a seizure needs emergency care.
patterns: unconscious|passed out|fainted|not waking up|can'?t be woken|seizure|convuls\w+|(having|had) a fit

flags.reason: Heavy or uncontrollable bleeding needs emergency care.
Sudden loss of vision or a dark curtain over your sight needs urgent emergency care.
Sudden swelling of the lips, tongue or throat can be a severe allergic reaction.
If you are thinking about ending your life or have hurt yourself, please call 112 now. You are not alone.
patterns: suicid\w*|kill myself|end my life|self[- ]harm\w*|hurt(ing)? myself on purpose|harm myself|overdos\w+
me suicider|mettre fin a (mes jours|ma vie)|me tuer|me faire du mal

flags.reason: Labour or waters breaking needs immediate care.
patterns: perdu les eaux|poche des eaux|en train d'?accoucher|vais accoucher|contractions?\W+(\w+\W+){0,3}(toutes les|minutes)

flags.reason: A severe injury, such as a bone that looks out of place, needs emergency care.
patterns: bent the wrong way|bone (is )?sticking out|looks deformed|(just|been) (had a |in a )?(serious |bad |car )?accident|hit by a car
os qui (sort|depasse)|deform\w+|(viens|vient) d'?avoir un accident|accident grave|renverse par une voiture

flags.reason: A fever with a stiff neck, or a rash that does not fade when pressed, can be a sign of meningitis.
patterns: fievre\W+(\w+\W+){0,8}nuque raide|nuque raide\W+(\w+\W+){0,8}fievre|raideur (de la|dans la) nuque\W+(\w+\W+){0,8}fievre|fievre\W+(\w+\W+){0,8}raideur (de la|dans la) nuque
